macro.title: SpaceX Starship rocket splashes down in Pacific Ocean - BBC
macro.summary: The rocket - which had been due to orbit the planet six times on a 10-hour flight - ultimately returned after a three-hour flight.

macro.title: Treasury Takes Aim at Wall Street Tax Trades in New Notice - Bloomberg.com
macro.summary: The US Treasury Department took a big step toward curbing Wall Street’s tax-aware investing boom on Monday, with a notice signaling potential action on an array of strategies and a ruling that will limit the tax benefits of a booming ETF maneuver.

macro.title: OpenAI still doesn’t seem to have a handle on all of its rogue AI activity - TechCrunch
macro.summary: On Friday, OpenAI published a new site devoted to “misalignment reports” and the breadth of the incidents is alarming.

macro.title: MongoDB Stock Sinks 20% as CEO Departs for Meta. ‘Real Shocker,’ Says Analyst. - Barron's
